# Diwa Design System

Accessibility-first Web Component library. Stencil.js core with auto-generated React, Vue, and Angular wrappers.

## Build & Test

Run all commands from **repo root** (`diwa-design-system/`):

```bash
npm ci                    # Install (Node >= 20 required)
npm run dev               # Stencil watch + storefront dev server
npm run build             # Build core + all framework wrappers
npm run test              # Vitest unit tests
npm run test:ux           # UX/interaction contract tests
npm run type-check        # TypeScript check (storefront)
npm run build:storefront  # Build Next.js documentation site
npm run deploy:storefront # Build + deploy to Firebase Hosting
```

## Architecture

```
diwa-components/          @diwacopilot/components — Stencil core (edit here)
  src/components/         One directory per component (diwa-button/, diwa-input-text/, …)
  src/global/app.css      Design tokens as CSS custom properties on :root
  src/utils/              Shared style/utility helpers
  storefront/             Next.js documentation site
diwa-components-react/    Auto-generated wrappers — never edit manually
diwa-components-vue/      Auto-generated wrappers — never edit manually
diwa-components-angular/  Auto-generated wrappers — never edit manually
```

Wrapper packages are regenerated by `npm run build`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for PR workflow and package ownership.

## Conventions

**Component file layout** (`diwa-components/src/components/diwa-<name>/`):

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `diwa-<name>.tsx` | Stencil component class |
| `types.ts` | Exported prop union types |
| `diwa-<name>-styles.ts` | `getComponentCss()` function — CSS-in-JS injected into Shadow DOM |
| `diwa-<name>-utils.ts` | Pure utilities (ARIA builders, etc.) |
| `*.spec.ts` | Vitest unit tests (one per concern) |

**Styling:**
- Never hardcode color values — always use `var(--diwa-*)` CSS custom properties
- Styles are generated by `getComponentCss()` and injected as `<style>` in `render()` — no per-component `.css` files
- Token naming: `--diwa-{category}-{scale}` (primitive) → `--diwa-{component}-{prop}` (consumer API)

**Accessibility:** Include `getFocusStyle()`, `getHoverCapableStyle()`, and `getReducedMotionStyle()` in all interactive components.

**Control height lock:** Default `40px`, compact `32px` for all input controls (`diwa-input-*`), `diwa-select`, `diwa-switch`, `diwa-checkbox`. Do not change without explicit owner approval.

**Theming:** `@Prop({ reflect: true }) theme: Theme = 'dark'` writes `data-theme` to the host for CSS cascade.

**New component registration:** When adding `diwa-<name>`, update both:
1. `storefront/src/utils/generator/generator.tsx` (`DiwaTagNames`)
2. `storefront/src/types/custom-elements.d.ts` (`React.JSX.IntrinsicElements`)

**Version updates:** Update `/news/changelog` in the same PR as any package version bump.

**Local-only — never commit:** `prompts/`, `issues/`, `.codex/skills/`, `design-system/`
